data.name: Immaniel
data.long_meaning: Immaniel is derived from the Hebrew name עִמָּנוּאֵל (immanu-el), which means 'God is with us'. This name is a prophecy from the Old Testament book of Isaiah (7:14), announcing the arrival of Immanuel, who would later be identified as Jesus Christ.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the presence of God in the world, and particularly in the life of a believer.

in_hebrew.name: עימנואל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עימנואל הוא שם עברי שמקורו בשתי מילים: 'אלוהים' ו-'עמנו', שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא עמנו' או 'אלוהים עמנו'. זהו שם שמתייחס לנוכחותו של אלוהים בחייו של האדם, ומבטא את האמונה באלוהים כמלווה ומגן.

in_greek.name: Ἐμμανουήλ
in_greek.meaning: ὁ Θεὸς μεθ' ἡμῶν - Θεὸς ἦν ἡμῶν
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἐμμανουήλ (Ἐμμανουήλ) εἰς τὴν ἑλληνικὴν γλῶσσαν μεταφράζεται ὡς 'ὁ Θεὸς μεθ' ἡμῶν' ἤ 'Θεὸς ἦν ἡμῶν'. Αὐτὸς ὁ ὄνομα προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὴν ἑβραϊκὴν γλῶσσαν καὶ εἰς τὴν Καινήν Διαθήκην ἀναφέρεται ὡς σημεῖον τῆς θεολογίας τοῦ Θεοῦ.

in_latin.name: Immaniel
in_latin.long_meaning: Immaniel nomen Hebraeum est quod in linguam Latinam translatum potest ut 'Deus nobiscum' vel 'Deus est nobiscum'. Hoc nomen significationem habet profundam theologicam, quia exprimit ideam Dei praesentiam in vita hominum.

in_english.name: Immaniel
in_english.long_meaning: Immaniel, derived from Hebrew 'Immanuel', signifies 'God is with us' or 'God with us'. This name has profound biblical roots, specifically mentioned in Isaiah 7:14 and Matthew 1:23, symbolizing God's presence and covenant with humanity. It represents divine companionship, protection, and guidance.

biblical_reference.note: Immanuel is a significant name in the Bible, symbolizing God's presence with His people.

data.cultural_impact: Immaniel as a Christian name carries a deep cultural significance, reminding us of the promise of God's presence with His people. It is a testament to the belief that no matter where we go, or what challenges we face, God is always with us. It is a beautiful reminder of the comfort, protection, and companionship that God offers to His children.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name Immaniel holds profound significance as it represents the very essence of God's nature - that He is a God who is not distant or aloof, but one who is deeply involved in the lives of His people. It echoes Jesus' words from the Gospel of Matthew, where He reassures His disciples, "And lo, I am with you always, even unto the end of the world." (Matthew 28:20 KJV). In a world that can often feel lonely and empty, the name Immaniel serves as a powerful reminder of the reality of God's presence with us, offering comfort, strength, and encouragement in all circumstances.

historical_references.reference: In the Old Testament, the prophet Isaiah foretold the birth of a child whose name would be called Immanuel, meaning 'God with us'. This prophecy was fulfilled in the birth of Jesus Christ.
historical_references.time_period: 7th century BC (Isaiah's prophecy); 1st century AD (Jesus' birth)

historical_references.reference: The Crusades, a series of military campaigns sanctioned by the Catholic Church to recapture the Holy Land from Muslim control, led to the popularization of the name Immanuel. Knights returning from the Crusades often adopted the name as a reminder of God's presence with them during battle.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named John Immaniel in New York, United States credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Immaniel, which means "God with us". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
